basics.name: Mohan Lin
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Control Science and Engineering
basics.summary: I received the B.E. degree from the Department of Automation, Hangzhou Dianzi University, Hangzhou, China, in 2022. I am currently pursuing the Ph.D. degree in Control Science and Engineering at Hangzhou Dianzi University and working as a visiting Ph.D. student at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. My research focuses on uncertainty quantification and optimal operation of power systems. I am experienced in developing optimization models using Python/MATLAB with Gurobi and conducting transient stability simulations using Python with PowerWorld.

projects.name: Fundamental Theory and Technology of Autonomically Coordinated Regional Energy Internet Planning and Operation Based on Generalized Carbon Emission Trajectory

highlights: Investigated uncertainty-aware planning and operation of regional energy internet systems under carbon-neutrality targets.
Conducted research on stochastic production simulation, energy-carbon coupling, and coordinated operation of shared energy storage.

Developed data-driven state inference and optimization-based regulation strategies under uncertain operating conditions.

projects.name: Coordinated Control Technologies for County-Level Distribution Grids with Large-Scale Integration of Energy-Autonomous Microgrids
